description.en: Zero-dependency static + sandbox smoke detector for DeepSeek Harness plugins: one run covers repository static checks (R), cordis contract scanning (K), dynamic sandbox smoke (D) and catalog listing verification (CC).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件「完整性 + 运行流畅」一体检测器：零依赖，一次运行覆盖包结构静态检查（R）、cordis 契约扫描（K）、动态沙箱冒烟（D）与生态集合站清单校验（CC）四层。
